name: Osananajimi wa BL Suki na Kyuuketsuki
original_name: 幼なじみはBL好きな吸血鬼
source:
Souta's childhood friend Nene was always a fujoshi, 
but recently she's also become an immortal! 
A vampire bit her at the convenience store. 
Since she likes staying up all night playing BL games anyway 
her life as a fledgling bloodsucker isn't so different. 
But now she's doomed to repeat the same year of school. 
She'll never age. She'll never die. That's bad. 

Can Souta restore Nene's humanity? 
He searches for the one who turned her in the night street... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE146403.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
奏太的青梅竹马妮妮一直是个腐女，
但最近她还变成了不死者！
她在便利店被吸血鬼咬了。
反正她本来就喜欢熬夜玩BL游戏，所以作为一名新手吸血鬼，她的生活并没有太大变化。
可是，她注定要永远重复同一年的校园生活。
她不会长大，也不会死去。这可不妙。

奏太能让妮妮恢复人类身份吗？
他在夜晚的街道上寻找那个将她变成吸血鬼的人……

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE146403.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
